required.statement: When users import spreadsheets, invalid rows should be identified and previewed so customers can correct mistakes before finalizing the import.
required.mechanism: Implement a bounded experiment that previews import errors in real-time during spreadsheet uploads, highlighting invalid rows with specific error messages.
required.title: bench-import
required.summary: Enable real-time error preview during spreadsheet imports to allow users to correct invalid rows before finalizing the import process.
